deposit_style: carbonatite-hosted rare earth elements (Chilwa Alkaline Province)

evidence_layers.rationale: Carbonatite / nepheline-syenite complexes are the host. Map from licensed geology; score carbonatite highest.
Elevated total-count radiometrics flag K-Th-U enriched alkaline centres; DERIVED when processed from survey data.
Ring faults and radial fractures control carbonatite emplacement and fenite aureoles.
DEM-derived lineaments are an UNVERIFIED structural proxy — use only with mapped structures.
Magnetic highs mark magnetite-rich carbonatite cores. Optional: strengthens, never required alone.
Soil/stream REE (+Nb, P) anomalies are direct evidence. Optional until lab assays exist.

status: DRAFT — requires geologist review. No coordinates are pre-loaded; enter cited occurrences via the literature form.

preservation: Fenitised aureoles resist weathering; low relief preserves laterite-hosted enrichment
source: Mantle-derived carbonatite magmas of the Chilwa Alkaline Province
pathway: Ring fractures, radial dykes, lineament intersections
trap: Carbonatite plugs, fenite aureoles, residual laterite caps
